item.title: Sony Motion Picture Group CEO Calls Out “Despicable” Trump Video Depicting Obamas as Apes
item.description: Tom Rothman addressed the post while accepting the Impact Award on behalf of Sony at the African American Film Critics Association Awards, where Ryan Coogler, Chase Infiniti, Delroy Lindo and Wunmi Mosaku were also honored.

item.title: A Couple Invited Bad Bunny to Their Wedding. They Just Got Married During His Super Bowl Halftime Show
item.description: Bad Bunny’s electric performance was a celebration for all but especially for the couple that actually got married onstage.

item.title: Trump Calls Bad Bunny’s Super Bowl Halftime Show “Absolutely Terrible” and “Disgusting”
item.description: It seems the president didn't agree with the Grammy winner's message of love during the 2026 Super Bowl.

item.title: Liam Ramos, the 5-Year-Old Detained by ICE, Was Not the Boy in Bad Bunny’s 2026 Super Bowl Halftime Show
item.description: Following his set, some online users incorrectly theorized that the boy in his performance was Liam Ramos, though THR can confirm he was not involved in the show.

item.title: Seattle Seahawks Defeat New England Patriots to Win Super Bowl LX
item.description: With a score of 29-13, Seattle took home the Vince Lombardi Trophy on Sunday at Levi’s Stadium in Santa Clara, California.

item.title: Celebrities React to Bad Bunny’s Halftime Show: Adam Sandler, Kerry Washington Show Support While Jake Paul Shares Distaste
item.description: Following his 13-minute set, reviews began pouring in, with public figures utilizing social media to weigh in on the Grammy Award winner's landmark performance.

item.title: How Bad Bunny’s Super Bowl Halftime Show Put Boricua Culture on the World’s Stage
item.description: The Puerto Rican artist put a collective celebration of Caribbean Latino culture on full display.
